title: La Vecchia by Giorgione
description: Giorgione’s unflinching portrait of an old woman who points to herself, holding a scrap of paper that reads “col tempo,” with time. A rare look at age in a city that painted mostly young beauties.

title: The Pietà by Titian
description: The last painting by Titian, which he meant for his own tomb and left unfinished when he died of plague in 1576. Its rough, almost violent brushwork was finished by his pupil Palma il Giovane.

title: The Miracle of the Slave by Tintoretto
episode: Tintoretto, the Miracle of the Slave
description: Tintoretto’s breakthrough of 1548: St. Mark plunges headfirst from the sky to save a slave being tortured for venerating him. It was painted for the Scuola Grande di San Marco and now hangs in the Accademia.

title: The San Giobbe Altarpiece by Giovanni Bellini
description: Bellini’s great altarpiece of around 1480, painted for the church of San Giobbe, with the Virgin enthroned in a painted chapel that seemed to extend the real one. It is now in the Accademia.

title: The San Zaccaria Altarpiece by Giovanni Bellini
description: Painted in 1505, when Bellini was in his seventies, this calm, glowing altarpiece of the Virgin and saints is still in the church it was made for, near St. Mark’s.

title: The Last Supper by Tintoretto
description: Tintoretto’s last great work, finished in 1594: the table runs diagonally into a dark room full of servants and angels made of light. It hangs in Palladio’s church on the island of San Giorgio.

title: The Assumption by Titian
place: Frari church (Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari)
description: Titian’s huge altarpiece of the Virgin rising to heaven, unveiled in 1518 when he was about 30. Its bold color and movement made his name. It still fills the apse of the Frari church.

title: The synagogues of the Ghetto
description: On the five synagogues built from the 1500s inside the Venice Ghetto, hidden on the upper floors of ordinary buildings, each serving a different community of the city’s Jews, from Germany, Italy, Spain, and the eastern Mediterranean.
